name: navigator-prompt-guidance
body: The distributed agent-prompt surface: `opencode-suite/agents/*.md`, embedded in the apg binary via `include_str!` and installed by `apg init` into `~/.opencode/agents/`. It is where the navigator's non-negotiable rules and the agent-builder's generation rules live, so it is the surface that must carry the graph-first ordering and make every generated agent inherit it. Included files: `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` (the ordering rule) and `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` (rule 5, propagation to generated agents).
